reports.title: Riskified Reports Strong Third Quarter of 2026 with Accelerating Revenue and Gross Profit Growth

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: We now anticipate revenue to be between $427 million and $433 million, or $430 million at the midpoint, up from our prior range of between $400 million and $410 million. This reflects the flow-through of our third quarter revenue outperformance, as well as an incremental raise to our outlook based on the momentum we are seeing in the business.
We now anticipate Adjusted EBITDA to be between $39 million and $43 million, or $41 million at the midpoint, up from our prior range of $33 million to $39 million.

The primary factors that may determine where we fall within each range are the timing and ramping of new merchant go-lives and existing merchant upsells, our success in retaining our merchants, and the broader macro environment.
